div.div:
Notes
*1 QoS policy groups and their burst settings live in the ONTAP management plane. The AWS plane (console / FSx for ONTAP API) has no matching parameter.
*2 Split point: the AWS plane creates the file system and SVM. QoS is set and changed from inside the VPC via ONTAP REST / CLI.
